concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-getting-paid-on-demand-payouts]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service balance-platform on-demand bank-transfer guide for Customer Area/Transfers API requests, optional one-person review, asynchronous tracking and return-reason-gated retry; request/booking is not bank receipt.
warnings: Payout Service uses balance-platform Transfers API and must stay distinct from the legacy Online Payout API under `adyen-payouts` and from internal balance-account transfers.
The raw's later generic 'retry' fix bullet is constrained by its prior instruction not to retry a final return reason; do not promote unconditional replay.
Customer Area 'Instant' EUR 150 and TEST API v4 `fast` request with `amount.value: 60000` in EUR are separate examples, not one outcome.
